name: Haiti

findings.summary: Natcom, a joint venture of Vietnam's Viettel and the Haitian state, has run a national fixed and mobile network since 2011; by 2018 it reported about 1,800 2G/3G/4G sites, 6,000 km of fibre and 35% market share.

sources.publisher: Quan Doi Nhan Dan (People's Army Newspaper, Vietnam)

findings.analyst_inference: Pole third: Viettel (Vietnamese state/military-owned) operates the network, which per SPEC makes it the controller; the RAN/core equipment vendor is not named in any opened source, so a PRC or other vendor layer underneath cannot be excluded. Ownership stakes not stated. Vietnamese outlets are state-owned, tiered S4; site/fibre figures come from them. Capacity Media article undated. still_current true: 15th anniversary marked September 2026.

findings.summary: At Natcom's 15th-anniversary event, attended by the Prime Minister, the Viettel-owned operator began a pilot launch of 5G in Haiti; vendor, value and coverage were not disclosed.
findings.analyst_inference: Tier 2 as a pilot. Pole follows operator Viettel because the 5G equipment vendor is not named; recheck if a vendor surfaces.

findings.summary: Digicel selected Ericsson to supply its GSM mobile network in Haiti, with GPRS data, prepaid billing and roaming; contract terms were not disclosed.
findings.analyst_inference: Ericsson (Sweden) as equipment vendor, so third. Pre-2020 and still_current unchecked; Digicel's later 2017 ZTE 4G RAN deal covered its 26 Caribbean/Central American markets without naming Haiti (TelecomTV relaying a ZTE press release), so Haiti's current RAN vendor may have changed. Not coded as a separate finding because Haiti is not named.

facilities.null_reason: one search found no data-centre or AI-campus project since 2023; only a 2011 Cisco-equipped private data-centre announcement (Maison Henri Deschamps), out of scope

silicon.null_reason: no dedicated search; no accelerator purchases surfaced in network, data-centre or AI searches

models.null_reason: one search (French, incl. Taiwan cooperation) found no model-provider partnership or national model

applications.null_reason: one search found only UN-agency CCTV tenders for UN premises and a Dominican border-camera item; no Haitian state surveillance or e-government AI system with a named vendor

research_gaps: Who supplies Natcom's RAN and core (Viettel High Tech, Huawei, ZTE, Ericsson, Nokia), including the 2026 5G pilot?
Does Digicel Haiti now run ZTE Uni-RAN under Digicel's 2017 region-wide 4G deal, or still Ericsson? Digicel's ownership after its 2023 restructuring should be confirmed.
Vendor of the Haiti domestic/international submarine cable funded by Digicel (2012 RCR report, not opened) and any HMN Tech involvement.
Whether Taiwan (ICDF) funds any Haitian government data centre or e-government platform.
